d:
Rajni grew up at a Mobile Creches centre. When she lost her mother and brother, it was the place she turned to again. With a younger sister depending on her, Rajni trained as a care worker at the same centre. Her work paid for her sister’s education and marriage, and she kept working after her own marriage.
Today, she looks after children in the rooms where she once spent her own childhood.
For Rajni, this is more than a job. It is a way of giving other children the care and security that shaped her own early years.
